evals.prompt: I installed worktrunk with Homebrew but `wt switch feature-auth` only prints a path and does not actually move my shell there. I use Fish. Help me fix it and explain what changed.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses missing shell integration for Fish and uses Worktrunk-native setup steps to fix or verify it.

evals.prompt: I want three parallel agent worktrees in this repo: one for auth, one for a pagination bug, and one for docs cleanup. Show me the `wt` commands you would use to create them and launch agents directly in each worktree.
evals.expected_output: Uses `wt switch` with create and execute flags, with clear branch naming and agent-launch commands.

evals.prompt: Create a shared Worktrunk project config so every new worktree runs `pnpm install` before start and every merge runs `pnpm test`. Put the shared settings in the right config file and explain why that file is the right one.
evals.expected_output: Chooses `.config/wt.toml`, adds appropriate project hooks, and explains the shared-vs-personal config distinction.
